version: LOCK 43 V1 (9 Nov 2026) - Nahla, the beekeepers: the sick child and the overloaded donkey
builds_on: LOCK 34 runner, LOCK 36 (Gate of Mercy opens after chapter 2). Design references (not shown): Quran 16:69 (honey, healing); Abu Dawud 2548 (fear Allah regarding animals that cannot speak).

nahla.name: Nahla
nahla.text: Hives of clay and straw stand in rows on the hillside, and the bees are everywhere. Nahla's honey goes to every pharmacy in Ilmara.

work.label: Carry honey jars down the hill · 4 coins

nahla.title: The hillside masjid
nahla.text: A white masjid among the hives. Bees drift in through the window and nobody minds.
nahla.first: A beekeeper gives you a piece of comb wrapped in a leaf after the prayer.

people.name: Dawud

lines.wary: Dawud waves smoke at a hive. “Stand still. They don't know you.”
lines.friendly: “The bee takes from a hundred flowers and harms none of them. Learn from that.”

memory: “You sat with that boy all night. The bees know you now.”

people.name: Umm Yahya

lines.wary: Umm Yahya hurries past with a basket.
lines.warm: “Yahya asks every day when the traveller is coming back.”

memory: “You stayed. I'll never forget you stayed.”

people.name: Ayyub

lines.wary: Ayyub loads jars and doesn't stop to talk.
lines.warm: “My donkey walks faster for you than for me.”

memory: “You grabbed my stick. I was angry. Then I looked at her legs.”

missions.title: The sick child
missions.button: Umm Yahya is crying at her door

a.text: Umm Yahya's little son has had a fever for three days and won't eat. The healer lives in Shifara, far off. Dawud says honey in warm water helps, and that the boy needs someone with him while she sees to her other children.

choices.label: Sit with the boy through the night
Buy honey and herbs for her · 12 coins

sit.text: You sit by his bed, wiping his forehead and spooning honey water into him. Near Fajr the fever breaks and he asks for bread.

buy.text: Dawud sells you his best honey and a twist of herbs. Umm Yahya presses your hand without a word.

go.text: The next morning you hear the fever broke in the night.

sat: Sat all night with a sick child
bought: Bought honey for a sick child

a.text: On the hill road Ayyub's donkey has fallen under a load of honey jars twice its size. Ayyub is beating it to make it stand.

choices.label: Stop him and help unload half
Pay for a second donkey · 6 coins

help.text: You catch Ayyub's arm. He glares - then sees the donkey's legs shaking and lowers the stick. You carry half the jars between you and the donkey walks the rest.

hire.text: Ayyub hires a second donkey with your coins and splits the load. Both walk easily.

walk.text: Behind you, the beating goes on for a while, then stops.

helped: Stopped a man beating his donkey
